title: 009 · Access route for a bulky delivery

coordinator.name: Iona Quill

recipient.name: Sena Korr

goal: Get the recipient's confirmation of the access route against the crew's checklist and the delivery team's acceptance of it, so that the booking stays active.

The checklist is the crew's requirement, not advice to move heavy furniture yourself.
